name: dock
title: Dock
blurb: macOS-style dock with icon magnification on hover.
description: Dock component (magic-ui) with icon magnification. Icons scale up smoothly as mouse approaches. Customizable icon size, magnification, and direction (top/middle/bottom).
use_when: Desktop-like UX or app launchers where macOS-style magnification feels familiar.
avoid_when: Touch interfaces or cramped horizontal space; magnification needs room.
a11y: Dock items are keyboard-focusable. Icons have aria-label or sr-only text. Magnification is visual only, not critical for use.
